auditor.evidence: The Audit Committee dealt at length with the financial statements at its meeting on 17 March 2023. At the meeting on 22 March 2023, the Supervisory Board examined the parent company and Group financial statements of Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft as well as the management reports of the parent company and the Group. Representatives of the auditor attended the above-mentioned meetings of the Audit Committee and the plenary Supervisory Board, where they explained the main findings of the audit and answered questions.
